title: Wiggle Little Toes
text:
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Tap them soft where the sunshine goes.
Clap your hands and touch your nose,
Up we stretch, and down we close!

Hop like a bunny, one, two, three,
Buzz like a bumble on a tree.
Spin around and count to four,
Then tiptoe softly to the door.

Yawn a yawn and hug your bear,
Sleepy stars are everywhere.
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Goodnight, goodnight, off she goes.

title: Wiggle Little Toes
text:
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Tap them where the sunshine goes!
Clap your hands and count to three,
One, two, three — now dance with me!

Stretch up tall like apple trees,
Sway your branches in the breeze.
Hop like bunnies, soft and slow,
Round and round the garden go!

Now we tiptoe, quiet mouse,
Sleepy fingers, sleepy house.
Yawn a yawn and hug a bear,
Goodnight toes and goodnight hair!

title: Wiggle Little Toes
text:
Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Tap them softly, off we go!
Clap your hands and count to three,
One, two, three — now wiggle with me!

Stretch your arms up to the sky,
Wave hello as clouds float by.
Spin around and touch the ground,
Jump up high without a sound!

Wiggle, wiggle, little toes,
Time to rest now, off we doze.

title: Four Little Seasons
text:
Spring brings raindrops, plip-plop-plee,
Little green buds on every tree.
Summer sun is warm and bright,
Fireflies blinking in the night.
Autumn leaves go swish and swirl,
Red and yellow, twist and twirl.
Winter snow falls soft and slow,
Mittens on and out we go!
Round and round the seasons play,
Here comes another sunny day!

title: Soup Pot Bubble
text:
Stir the soup pot, round and round,
Bubble, bubble, what a sound!
In go carrots, orange and sweet,
In go noodles, curly treat.
Sprinkle pepper, one, two, three,
Stir it slow and count with me.
Blow it cool and take a sip,
Warm and happy, drip drip drip!
Soup pot bubble, soup pot hum,
Supper's ready — everyone come!

title: The Rain Goes Pitter-Pat
text:
The rain goes pitter, pitter-pat,
It taps upon my yellow hat.
The wind goes whoosh and swirls around,
And swishes leaves along the ground.

The sun peeks out and says hello,
And paints a great big colored bow.
The puddles shine, the sky is blue,
So splash and stomp and jump right through!

Pitter-pat and whoosh and shine,
Every kind of day is fine!

title: Pancake Pat
text:
Pancake Pat has pancakes three,
One for you and two for me!
Flip them high, flip them low,
Watch that pancake pop and go!

Berries red and butter gold,
Eat them up before they're cold.
Sticky fingers, happy grins,
Lick the syrup off our chins!

Pancake Pat says, "Have some more!"
Stack them up right through the door!

title: Sunny Says Good Morning
text:
Sunny peeks in, bright and new,
Hop right up, the day says "Boo!"
Stretch your arms and touch the sky,
Wave to sleepy clouds bye-bye.

Splash-splash water on my nose,
Brush my teeth in tidy rows.
One sock, two socks, shirt goes on,
Wiggle till the buttons're done.

Spoon and bowl and one big grin,
Breakfast time, let's dig right in!
Out the door and off I go —
Good morning, world, hello, hello!

title: Deep Green Woods
text:
Tall green trees stand in a row,
Mossy paths where mushrooms grow.
Hop a log and count to three,
A bushy squirrel waves at me!

Owl says whoo from way up high,
Ferns go swish as we walk by.
Acorns tumble, plip-plop-plunk,
Rabbit hides behind a trunk.

Wave goodbye to every tree,
The woods will wait for you and me!
